explanations.message: Training age novice (2 months of consistent training).
Beginner exercises only for the first 8 weeks of logged training.
Tier 1 (full VOL-04 band): chest, side_delts, lats, upper_back, quads, hamstrings, glutes; tier 2 (0.6 × band): rear_delts, biceps, triceps, abs, calves; tier 3 has no target.
First mesocycle as a novice: 12 weeks, no scheduled deload (reactive only).

Sets are fitted into 60-minute sessions (≈ 1.75–4 min per set incl. rest), ≤ 20 sets per session, ≤ 12 sets per muscle per session and ≥ 2 sets per exercise; a prime mover earns 1 set, a synergist 0.5.
Each week covers knee-dominant, hinge, horizontal and vertical/incline push and pull patterns; 62 % of the sets are compounds (target 60–75 %).
